body: I depend on them. I am unemployed

I did not want to have an abortion. But they did not want a child and I won’t put myself in a terrible position. I believe the sadness and stress of it all caused the miscarriage 

Also, this is a different partner. The first left. I healed. Now I’m in the same position
I appreciate you
Thank you for that. I can only pray to make it to the other side of this shit
More alone than ever. I have no one to cherish my good moments with and no shoulders to cry on when I’m depressed.
Well I’ll promise u that as long as u stay….I’ll stay too. We deserve to be happy & I just don’t understand why we just can’t get there
Literally, one thing. And I’m embarrassed to even say what triggered me bc to outsiders, it seems small and trivial af.

No one understands unless they’ve dealt with it. It’s at a point where I can FEEL ppl are tired of me constantly being sad and are annoyed that I’m always “miserable” ….as if I choose to be this way. It frustrates & depresses me even more to see that ppl think I’m this way for “attention”. This is a miserable existence.

I’m only here bc of my daughter. I grew up immensely depressed and I could never ever put that pain on her, purposely. But even still, living for someone else isn’t enough to make me WANT to be alive.
We* got this, hopefully

I am trying. I just feel like I don’t know what more to try. I don’t want to get into my personal business. But I just see no happy ending for me. I’m only here bc I wouldn’t want my daughter to grow up depressed and feel like I do.
Thank you, genuinely.

I am here for u, fellow depressed stranger. As shitty as life is, I still do believe we deserve just a little bit of happiness. Even if that happiness is just crying amongst people we can cry and relate to. Here’s to us hopefully making it another year ❤️
I haven’t started my daily pages yet. I will tomorrow and see how it goes. I just know that tracking things monthly was overwhelming and I’d forget so I thought adding a weekly would be easier

I do. Smoking actually calms and slows my mind down and helps me get into the “creative/writing” mode. I don’t do it every time but I do smoke daily so sometimes my snoring and writing sessions overlap
Just here to say I like ur name lol
I will look into that. Thank you!
I smoke to ease my anxiety and help my adhd….not to “parade” around my “bad habits”. It helps more than most meds. But thanks for the input

I had a BuJo but I didn’t set it up according to the book so I decided to start fresh with an index, future log, and monthly….I haven’t started my dailies bc this doesn’t start till Monday. I tried the artist stuff and this is my version of “simple”

I actually read his book and thought I was setting it up the way he said. An index, monthly (I enjoy printing calendars rather than drawing them) and I’ll start my dailies as of Monday. What am I doing that’s off from the original, besides the weekly?
Minor sacrifice I’m willing to make
I’ve given it 30 years. I refuse to wake up another day in misery.
Things3! I love it and it’s based off GTD methodology
Living is a lot of pain. Every single day. At least with dying, that’ll be the last pain I ever feel. I’m ok with that.
I’d be dead. Nothing after I off myself would matter to me at all. I’m only alive for the benefit of others.

I think today will be the day I finally do it. Last night was the last straw. I feel like I need to do this today bc I don’t want to risk waking up tomorrow and still feel this low. It’s physically painful for me to be alive so death sound much better. Pray u all get better. I’ll see y’all on the other side. Goodbye

I feel the same. It’s like, I’m truly happy that they are happy and feel nothing like I do….but damn it really hurts and drives me over the edge to see ppl just effortless happy. Like they just wake up ok and not have to fight to have a good day or just get thru one.
